technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The declared products is M10, 144 Cells TOPCon Bifacial Solar Module.The Topcon Product has specification such as up to 80% bifaciality factor, N-type Topcon, Power Generation – Green Energy, 30 Years service life. TOPCon technology (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) enhances efficiency by reducing recombination losses and improving energy output
technology.technologicalApplicability: The M10, 144 Cells TOPCon Bifacial Solar Module is used for electricity generation
